summary: Split γ = u·η with u ∈ 𝖴 and η ∈ U(X₀)(E); the 𝖧-part of the position lies in K(g), so freeness of the classes forces c = d and η = 1.

steps.claim: Write γ = u·toBesselH(η) with u ∈ 𝖴(E) and η ∈ U(X₀)(E) (exists_besselU_mul_toBesselH). The position h_c⁻¹γh_d = (h_c⁻¹uh_c)·(h_c⁻¹η h_d) lies in K(g), the first factor in 𝖴 and the second in 𝖧, so the second factor lies in K(g) (mem_unitaryLevel_of_besselU_mul); by K_c = inclHFin⁻¹(K(g)) (IsAdmissible) this says c̃⁻¹ η d̃ ∈ K_c, and since the classes have trivial stabilisers (aut_columnLevel), c = d and η = 1 (eq_and_eq_one_of_doubleCoset_rep). Then γ = u ∈ 𝖴(E) with h_c⁻¹γh_c ∈ K(g), i.e. γ ∈ 𝖴_c(g).
